fields.label: Box Packing Rules
fields.description: Off = no box maths and no order minimum. Turn on only after pack rates are entered on your box Items.

fields.label: Default Box Type
fields.description: Seeds each new cart line. Must be an Item flagged Is Box with a pack rate.

fields.label: Minimum Order (Stems)
fields.description: 0 = no minimum. Checked against the whole cart, not per line.

fields.label: Delivery Lead Time (Days)
fields.description: Earliest shipping date a buyer may request, and the fallback when none is given.

fields.options:
One theme covers the storefront and the customer portal. Anything you change here shows in both.

You set source colours; the rest is derived:

  • Accent → hover, light and deep shades, the button gradient, the focus ring
  • Ink → the full 7-step grey scale and every card shadow
  • Page Canvas → page background and the lifted surface tone
  • Each status colour → a darker or brighter partner plus a soft badge tint

Blank means the shipped default. A site with nothing set here sends no colour overrides at all, so clearing a field always returns it to the stock Ink & Gold design. Changes apply on the next page load — save, then reload the storefront.

Text over the accent (buttons, avatar) is chosen automatically as pure black or pure white, whichever measures more readable against your accent. You do not set it.

fields.label: Brand Colors
fields.description: Set a few source colours; the rest of the palette is worked out from them. Every field is optional — blank means the shipped default, and a site with none set sends no overrides at all. These colours apply to the storefront AND the customer portal.

fields.label: Accent
fields.description: Price chips, badges, the bold half of the wordmark, the basket count, chart series, hero italics and focus rings. With Accent Drives Primary Actions ticked it also paints every primary button, the active nav pill and the avatar. Blank = shipped gold.

fields.label: Accent Dark
fields.description: The deep end of the button gradient, and accent-coloured text on white. Blank = the accent darkened 25%.

fields.label: Accent Soft (tint)
fields.description: The pale tint behind accent badges and “Your price” chips. Blank = a near-white wash of the accent.

fields.label: Accent Drives Primary Actions
fields.description: Off: the accent is trim only and near-black paints buttons, the active nav pill and avatars. On: those take the accent instead, while headings and body text stay ink. Tick this when the client's brand colour is their action colour.

fields.label: Ink / Neutral
fields.description: Headings and body text — and the source of the whole 7-step grey scale plus every card shadow, so this single field re-tints most of the page. Storefront and portal both.

fields.label: Muted Text
fields.description: Secondary text: card descriptions, table meta lines, sidebar labels, “filed on” dates. Set it to control how warm or cool your greys look; left blank they are a straight blend of Ink and Canvas and can look flat.

fields.label: Page Canvas
fields.description: The page background behind every card, plus the slightly lighter surface used by table headers and the portal sidebar card.

fields.label: Muted Fill
fields.description: Sunken fills: table row hover, quiet panels, the search box background. Should be a little darker than the canvas.

fields.label: Border
fields.description: Hairlines: card edges, table row dividers, input borders, section rules.

fields.label: Border (strong)
fields.description: Heavier dividers and the border on outlined buttons.

fields.label: Status Colors
fields.description: Each one fills out a whole family: the flat colour, a darker or brighter partner, and a soft translucent tint for badge backgrounds.

fields.label: Success
fields.description: “In stock” badges, paid invoices, accepted quotations, resolved claims.

fields.label: Warning
fields.description: Unpaid and pending states, orders in progress, claims under review. Set the darker text shade — the brighter fill is derived from it.

fields.label: Danger
fields.description: “Out of stock”, overdue invoices, declined quotations, rejected claims.

fields.label: Info
fields.description: Neutral informational badges and secondary chart series.

fields.label: Typography
fields.description: Bundled families need no internet connection. Choose Custom to use any Google font — you must give both the family name and the stylesheet URL.

fields.label: Body Font
fields.description: Body text, buttons, labels, tables — nearly everything.

fields.label: Display Font
fields.description: Large headings: the hero headline, page titles, panel headings and the footer wordmark.

fields.label: Mono Font
fields.description: Numbers and codes: SKUs, eyebrow labels, document numbers, KPI figures.

fields.label: Google Fonts URL
fields.description: Needed only for Custom families. Must start https://fonts.googleapis.com — any other host is refused, because this adds a tag to every page.

fields.label: Shape
fields.description: Corner rounding. Any CSS length: 4px, 0.75rem, or 0 for square corners.

fields.label: Base Radius
fields.description: Inputs, buttons, badges and small controls. Blank = 0.75rem.

fields.label: Card Radius
fields.description: Product cards, KPI tiles, category cards. Blank = 20px.

fields.label: Panel Radius
fields.description: Large panels, the portal sidebar card, dialogs and drawers. Blank = 24px.

fields.label: Active Occasion
fields.description: Seasonal overlay applied on top of the theme above. Blank means none. Nothing is written to the settings — clearing this restores the base theme exactly.

fields.label: Runs Until
fields.description: After this date the overlay stops applying. Leave blank to run until you clear it.

fields.label: Banner Text
fields.description: Overrides the occasion's own wording — put your order cutoff date here.

fields.label: Custom CSS
fields.description: Applied last, inside :root, so it overrides anything above. Use it to pin one specific token rather than fighting the derivation — e.g. --ws-ink-4: #54586b;

fields.label: Primary Color (legacy)
fields.description: Superseded by Accent. Retained for one release.

fields.label: Identity
fields.description: Who the site belongs to: the name and marks that appear in the navigation bar and footer.

fields.label: Wordmark
fields.description: Light-weight part, e.g. 'mona'.

fields.label: Wordmark (bold)
fields.description: Accented part, e.g. 'flowers'.

fields.label: Brand Logo
fields.description: Shown in the navigation bar and, on a white plate, in the footer. Square marks and wide wordmarks both work. Blank = the shipped Upande logo.

fields.label: Favicon
fields.description: The small icon in the browser tab. Square, ideally 64×64px or larger.

fields.label: Hero
fields.description: The large banner across the top of the storefront — background photo, headline and buttons. Switch the whole band off in Features → Hero.

fields.label: Hero Image
fields.description: Background photo of the hero banner on /store. Landscape works best, around 2000×1000px; it is cropped to fill and darkened so the headline stays readable. Blank = the shipped photo.

fields.label: Heading (emphasis)
fields.description: Rendered italic in the display face.

fields.label: Secondary CTA (guest)
fields.description: Ignored when Signup is off; guests then see Member login.

fields.label: Hero Stats
fields.description: Empty = the stat row is omitted.

fields.label: Category Cards
fields.description: Empty = the card grid is omitted.

fields.label: How Ordering Works
fields.description: The three-step explainer band beneath the catalogue on /store. Leave the table empty to hide the whole band.

fields.label: Heading (emphasis)
fields.description: Rendered italic in the display face, following the heading.

fields.label: Steps
fields.description: Numbered in table order — 01, 02, 03. Three fits the layout best.

fields.label: Copyright Holder
fields.description: The year is prepended automatically.

fields.label: Category Card Images (legacy)
fields.description: Superseded by the Category Cards table. Migrated automatically; retained one release.

fields.options:
Unticking a feature does three things: hides it from the interface, makes its page return “not found”, and refuses the underlying request. A switched-off feature is genuinely unreachable — there is no leftover address a customer can still use.

Portal is a master switch: off closes every portal page whatever the individual boxes say, and turning it back on restores exactly the arrangement you had.

How the portal behaves — dashboard ranges, claim types, what customers may edit — lives in Webstore Portal Settings, not here.

fields.label: Storefront
fields.description: Unticking hides the UI, 404s the route and rejects the API.

fields.label: Cart & Checkout
fields.description: Off = browse-only catalog.

fields.label: Direct Ordering
fields.description: Adds a Place order button at checkout that creates a draft Sales Order (type Shopping Cart). Off leaves quotation-only checkout.

fields.label: Signup
fields.description: Self-registration. Off by default: accounts are created by the sales team via Webstore Portal Access.

fields.label: Portal
fields.description: Master switch for every /portal page.

fields.label: Shipped Presets
fields.description: Applying a preset overwrites every Theme, Branding and Features value.

fields.label: Preset
fields.description: Shipped configurations. Apply from the Theme menu above.

fields.label: Theme JSON
fields.description: Attach an exported theme, then use Theme → Import Theme.
